benchmark: TRUYN Semantic v2 BGE aligned-facet coverage hard-pair diagnostic
importantFinding: The isolated operational-action facet ranked the expected target above the previous wrong passage in all 3/3 eligible hard cases. Whole-passage domain/condition scoring remained contaminated by unrelated passage terms, so no generic aggregation reached 3/3.
conclusion: Aligned query facets expose the decisive operational signal, but BGE scoring of each facet against the entire passage still allows other passage fields to contaminate domain/condition relevance. This architecture is not accepted. The next experiment should use an instruction-aware conjunction reranker or aligned document facets rather than tune aggregation weights on this hard set.
